lines: That red is the best part!
It's the color of passion. Ah,
it takes me back to my youth.
I was madly in love.
Oh, that one!
What a beautiful stone. And so big!
We'll see her in it soon.
Other ladies will want one, too.
They're in fashion? I had no idea.
They're called chili peppers.
A kind of spice, I'm told.
They suit our local food perfectly.
Hmph! No eye for a bargain, I see!
Was she a celestial maiden? Heh...
What a foolish thought.
Please take it.
I won't feel right otherwise.
Hmm... 150,000 coins.
Meet me there, please.
This rope's still good.
We can wait to replace it.
Ho ho ho! Looks like he wants it.
You want something besides food?
Now that's a surprise. What weapon?
There was a great sea battle.
She fought in it, and they say
that's where she lost her sword.
They say the blade's tinged red,
like it's drunk its fill of blood.
I can see why he'd do that.
What became of the sword?
I never did hear where he hid it.
Let's look if we get the chance.
What a pretty square... Wait.
Something's in that little pond.
Is that...?
You know it? That's wonderful!
Who's your favorite commander?
Me? Come on. I'm no one that grand.
Judas was a disciple of Jesus,
one of the twelve.
His sword may still lie
in a place associated with him.
I shall write again if I hear more.
Janus Pasar
...Well, I won't object outright.
Judas did repent in the end.
It's your decision, Admiral.
